header.name: Networks and Systems Security II
header.description: This course derives is sequel to the Networks and Systems Security (CSE352/552) that was taught in Winter 2019. The core theoretical concepts build up on where Networks and System Security left. However, a significant volume of the course material focuses largely on hands-on networks and systems security tools, and how to use them to exploit network and system vulnerabilities, besides the traditional system development exercises.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Ability to use various network security tools.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Abilitiy to identify of basic network and system level vulnerabilities and learning techniques/tools to identify them.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Ability to design and implement various network access control and security postures.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Ability to design and implement various security postures using system and network based cryptographic frameworks like OpenSSL.

outcomes.label: CO5
outcomes.raw_text: Ability to design and use various network evasion tools

lecture_topics: Basics of systems and network security

weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Assignment – Designing your own rudimentary kernel firewall

lecture_topics: Network access controls - ISP scale blacklists/DNS filtering/DNS injection/middleboxes
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Exercise - Using Linux iptables; Lab: Hands on experience with linux firewalling system viz. iptables

lecture_topics: Network security assesment tools/engines --  wireshark, tcping, tcptraceroute, iperf, dig, nslookup, nmap, zmap, shodan , censys
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Exercise - Using network reconnaisance tools and services to identify and report vulnerabilities; Lab: Hands on with various security and reconnaissance tools
Assignment - basic shell code injection attack

lecture_topics: Offensive tools to exploit remote vulnerabilities - shell code generation and injection injection, password sniffing, cracking etc. using Metasploit
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Exercise - using metaspoilt to design and inject shell code; Lab: Hand on experience using metaspolit to do shell code injection

lecture_topics: More on offensive tools - threat hunting
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Exercise - using metaspoilt for remote server exploitation; Lab: Hand on experience using metaspolit for remote server exploitation

lecture_topics: Basics of confidentiality, integrity and authentication paradigms
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Exercise -- OpenSSL framework for file encryption and integrity protection; Lab: Hands on experince using openssl framework for file encryption and decryption

lecture_topics: CIA implementations - case study SSL v1/v2/v3
CIA implementations - VPNs and tunnelling protocols
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Exercise -- Using openVPN and IKE tools; Lab: VPNs

lecture_topics: SSL MITM tools -- ssltrip, burp suite, etc.
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Exercise - using various MITM tools and scraping web traffic.; Lab: SSL MITM

lecture_topics: Basics of Network Anonymity - Mix Networks and Onion Routing
Practical Network Anonymity and Privacy - Tor
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Exercise - Setting up your own private Tor network with configurable parameters; Lab: Private Tor setup
